memories.body:
Learned policy for claim class SLOW: trust a memory for 20000 checkpoints.
FALSE-STALE=6, MISSED-CHANGE=0, samples=6 (same observer run, up to the learning event).
FALSE-STALE 3 > MISSED-CHANGE 0: widen 10000 -> 20000.
Rule: FALSE-STALE (window said stale, subject pin unchanged) widens the window x2; MISSED-CHANGE (window said fresh, subject pin changed) tightens it /2.
A window change requires at least 3 actionable samples since the last change; CONSISTENT and UNVERIFIED never move the window.
Bounds for class SLOW: window_checkpoints in [10, 2000000].
